front_matter.preface: Pa o Kachatbingna Kasa wui Khararchan: The Acts of the Apostles in Tangkhul Naga, translated by Rev. William Pettigrew. Published in London by the British and Foreign Bible Society, 1905; printed at the Baptist Mission Press, Calcutta. Details the day of Pentecost, Peter's defense before the Sanhedrin, Stephen's martyrdom, and Paul's speech at the Areopagus in Athens.

chapters.title: Kazingli Kaphan kala Kachatbing (Ascension and Commission)
chapters.summary: The ascension of Christ from the Mount of Olives and the gathering of the apostles in Jerusalem.
chapters.tangkhul_text: Theophilus-li kaphung kakhanin: Jesu-na khararchanli ot kasawui maram kaphung-kachungli kaphika thotsai. Awui thikahaiwui saphunga A haringkasa theichithei kachiva thotna athumli thang taracham kachithei Varivarawui kazingramwui tui hosa. Mangan Kathara nithumwui kachungli raranglikha nithum pangmashan phunglikha; kala Jerusalemli, Judea kala Samaria ram kachivali, kala ngalei pammai kashung kachivali Iwui sakhibing salikha. Athumna theishak phashokda Matthiasli rasai, kala aya kachatbing tarakhatli ngasohailsai.
chapters.english_translation: The former treatise have I made, O Theophilus, of all that Jesus began both to do and teach. To whom also he shewed himself alive after his passion by many infallible proofs, being seen of them forty days. But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judaea, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth. And they gave forth their lots; and the lot fell upon Matthias; and he was numbered with the eleven apostles.
chapters.grammar_notes: Tangkhul uses the indigenous legal term 'sakhibing' (witnesses) for those testifying under solemn oath.

exercises.question: How long was Jesus seen by the apostles after His passion?
Who was chosen to take the place of Judas among the twelve?

chapters.title: Pentecost Thangli Mangan Kathara (Day of Pentecost)
chapters.summary: The descent of the Holy Spirit like rushing wind and tongues of fire, and Peter's first sermon.
chapters.tangkhul_text: Pentecost kumshang phungphatli nithum pam akhangli zikahai pamsai. Kazingwui huchiphung majung katha khara rasai, kala athum pamsahai shim kachivali kapingsai. Kala meiwui malei katha khangayeida athum kachivawui kachungli rasai. Kala athum kachiva Mangan Katharana kapingda ngatei tui khangayei hosa! Peterna ngakarangda hosa: Israel miwung, tui hi ngashonlu: Nazarethwui Jesu hili Varivarana thikahaiwui ngachaili thingkashangsai; chiwui maramli ithum kachiva sakhibing thotsai. Ningzan ngashunlu, kala nithum kachiva Jesu Christawui minli baptisma sayanlu!
chapters.english_translation: And when the day of Pentecost was fully come, they were all with one accord in one place. And suddenly there came a sound from heaven as of a rushing mighty wind, and it filled all the house where they were sitting. And there appeared unto them cloven tongues like as of fire, and it sat upon each of them. And they were all filled with the Holy Ghost, and began to speak with other tongues. Then Peter stood up and said, Ye men of Israel, hear these words; This Jesus hath God raised up, whereof we all are witnesses. Repent, and be baptized every one of you in the name of Jesus Christ.

vocabulary.meaning: to repent, rectify the mind and heart

chapters.grammar_notes: The verbal phrase 'ningzan ngashunlu' fuses 'ningzan' (heart-contrition) with 'ngashun' (to make straight).

exercises.question: Describe the signs that accompanied the descent of the Holy Spirit at Pentecost.
What did Peter urge the crowd to do at the conclusion of his sermon?

chapters.title: Temple Gate wui Pamli Thotkhamatei (Lame Man at the Beautiful Gate)
chapters.summary: Healing of the lame man by Peter and John at the Beautiful Gate of the Temple.
chapters.tangkhul_text: Peter kala John thangkhamir pung chiko khangamor thangli Templeli zangvangasai. Phaphuk khazat akhat, awui phankahaiwui thotli theisai, aya Templewui Mathan Gate kahowali pamsai; aya Peter kala Johnli theida seisan khamor khanasai. Peterna hosa: Rupa kala sona iwui chungli mathai mana; kha ina phungli nali khamlikha: Nazarethwui Jesu Christawui minli ngakarangda zatlu! Kala ayana awui pangkasho pangda thingkasangsai; chitharan awui phakhur kala pharu pangmashan phungsai! Aya ngachor-da ngakarangsai kala zat-zangsai, Templeli zangda khangachor kala Varivarali mathankashei sasai.
chapters.english_translation: Now Peter and John went up together into the temple at the hour of prayer, being the ninth hour. And a certain man lame from his mother's womb was carried, whom they laid daily at the gate of the temple which is called Beautiful, to ask alms of them that entered into the temple. Then Peter said, Silver and gold have I none; but such as I have give I thee: In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth rise up and walk. And he took him by the right hand, and lifted him up: and immediately his feet and ankle bones received strength. And he leaping up stood, and walked, and entered with them into the temple, walking, and leaping, and praising God.

vocabulary.meaning: lame from birth, crippled in the feet

chapters.grammar_notes: The paired coordinate 'rupa kala sona' uses standard Loan-Assamese roots fully naturalized in colonial Tangkhul.

exercises.question: At what hour did Peter and John go up to the Temple?
What memorable response did Peter give when asked for alms?

chapters.title: Councilwui Phungli Sakhi Chitheikahai (Before the Sanhedrin)
chapters.summary: Peter and John arrested and questioned before the rulers, elders, and scribes of the Council.
chapters.tangkhul_text: Athumna Peter kala Johnli ngachaili pamsahai hosa: Khipawui pangmashan kala minli nithumna hi sakha? Peterna Mangan Katharana kapingda hosa: Miwungwui khararbing kala Israelwui Hangvabing, ngatei khipawui chunglikha haring kaphan mathailak mana; maramchilu kazing kaphungli miwungli khami ngatei min khikha mathai mana! Kha athumna Peter kala Johnna ngahanda hosa: Nithumwui tui ngashon-katha Varivarawui tui ngashon-katha khipana mashungkha nithum shanshilu! Maramchilu ithumna theikahai kala ngashokahai tui masasa pamtang mathailak mana.
chapters.english_translation: And when they had set them in the midst, they asked, By what power, or by what name, have ye done this? Then Peter, filled with the Holy Ghost, said unto them, Ye rulers of the people, and elders of Israel, Neither is there salvation in any other: for there is none other name under heaven given among men, whereby we must be saved. But Peter and John answered and said unto them, Whether it be right in the sight of God to hearken unto you more than unto God, judge ye. For we cannot but speak the things which we have seen and heard.

vocabulary.meaning: council of elders, senators, Sanhedrin magistrates
under heaven, beneath the celestial dome
to hearken, obey, submit to authority

chapters.grammar_notes: Pettigrew uses the indigenous administrative title 'Hangvabing' (village elder bench) for the Sanhedrin rulers.

exercises.question: How did Peter respond to the council's prohibition against preaching?
Explain the cultural borrowing of 'Hangva' in early Tangkhul scriptural translation.

chapters.title: Stephenwui Pao kala Kashung Thot (The Martyrdom of Stephen)
chapters.summary: Stephen's defense before the council, vision of the Son of Man, and stoning as the first Christian martyr.
chapters.tangkhul_text: Stephenna ning-kachang kala pangmashan phungda miwungwui ngachaili theichithei kaphung sasai. Council shimli pambing kachivana ali theida awui mai kazingram kachisowui mai katha theisai. Kha aya Mangan Katharana kapingda kazingli theida Varivarawui mathankashak theisai. Kala athumna lungna chidatli Stephenna khon-kaphung: O Mapao Jesu, iwui mangankhali khaphanlu! Kala aya phakhur phumda kaho: O Mapao, kakhama hi athumwui chungli machonlu! Hi hoda aya thikahaisai. Saulna awui thikahaili ningkachang phungsai.
chapters.english_translation: And Stephen, full of faith and power, did great wonders and miracles among the people. And all that sat in the council, looking stedfastly on him, saw his face as it had been the face of an angel. But he, being full of the Holy Ghost, looked up stedfastly into heaven, and saw the glory of God. And they stoned Stephen, calling upon God, and saying, Lord Jesus, receive my spirit. And he kneeled down, and cried with a loud voice, Lord, lay not this sin to their charge. And when he had said this, he fell asleep. And Saul was consenting unto his death.

vocabulary.meaning: calling out with loud voice, invoking
lay not to charge, impute not
kneeled down, fell on knees in prayer

chapters.grammar_notes: Instrumental postposition '-na' on 'lungna' marks the lethal physical instrument: by means of stones.

exercises.question: What two prayers did Stephen utter before his death?
Who was recorded as consenting to Stephen's death?

chapters.title: Corneliusli Pao Kazang (Conversion of Cornelius)
chapters.summary: Peter's vision of the clean and unclean animals, journey to Caesarea, and the gospel opened to the Gentiles.
chapters.tangkhul_text: Caesarea ramli Cornelius kahona Italian cohortwui centurion akhat pamsai. Aya Varivarali kacharan, awui shim kachiva ngasoda, miwungli dori khami kala Varivarali thang kachiva khangamor. Peterna Caesareali rada hosa: Kaphung-kachangli ina theisai Varivarana mi akhatli kaching mei mana; kha ram kachivali Ali kacharan kala mashungkasa chi Awui ningkachang phungsai. Peterna tui hi holikha Mangan Katharana tui ngashonbing kachivawui chungli rasai!
chapters.english_translation: There was a certain man in Caesarea called Cornelius, a centurion of the band called the Italian band, A devout man, and one that feared God with all his house, which gave much alms to the people, and prayed to God alway. Then Peter opened his mouth, and said, Of a truth I perceive that God is no respecter of persons: But in every nation he that feareth him, and worketh righteousness, is accepted with him. While Peter yet spake these words, the Holy Ghost fell on all them which heard the word.

vocabulary.meaning: does not show partiality, no respecter of persons
alms, charitable offerings to the needy

chapters.grammar_notes: The negative comparative 'kaching mei mana' (literally: does not exceed in biased viewing) translates impartial justice.

exercises.question: What was the occupation of Cornelius in Caesarea?
What theological breakthrough did Peter announce in Acts 10:34-35?

chapters.title: Athens Ramli Paulna Tui Chitheikahai (Paul at the Areopagus)
chapters.summary: Paul's sermon at Mars Hill in Athens concerning the Unknown God, repentance, and resurrection.
chapters.tangkhul_text: Paulna Areopagus (Mars Hill) ngachaili ngakarangda hosa: Athens miwung, ina theisai nithum thang kachiva kameo khangamor phungsai; maramchilu ina zatli nithumwui altar akhatli kaphika theisai: MATHIKAHAI VARIVARALI. Nithumna matheila khangamor hili ina chitheikhami! Kazing kala ngalei kala chili leisatha kachiva sakahai Varivara chili kazing kala ngaleiwui Mapaosai, Aya mina sakahai templeli mapam mana; maramchilu Awui chungli ithum haring, zatta, kala pamsai; nithumwui la-kashabingna hokatha: 'Ithumya Awui kachung thotsai.'
chapters.english_translation: Then Paul stood in the midst of Mars' hill, and said, Ye men of Athens, I perceive that in all things ye are too superstitious. For as I passed by, and beheld your devotions, I found an altar with this inscription, TO THE UNKNOWN GOD. Whom therefore ye ignorantly worship, him declare I unto you. God that made the world and all things therein, seeing that he is Lord of heaven and earth, dwelleth not in temples made with hands; For in him we live, and move, and have our being; as certain also of your own poets have said, For we are also his offspring.

vocabulary.meaning: traditional nature spirits, idols, lesser deities
offspring, lineage, children of the divine

chapters.grammar_notes: Pettigrew contrasts indigenous 'Kameo' (animistic spirits) with the sovereign 'Varivara' (Creator of heaven and earth).

exercises.question: What inscription did Paul encounter in Athens?
How did Paul quote the Greek poets in Tangkhul?

pages.title: Chapter 1: Kazingli Kaphan kala Kachatbing (Ascension and Commission)
lines: CHAPTER 1: KAZINGLI KAPHAN KALA KACHATBING (ASCENSION AND COMMISSION)
Summary: The ascension of Christ from the Mount of Olives and the gathering of the apostles in Jerusalem.
TANGKHUL READING TEXT:
Theophilus-li kaphung kakhanin: Jesu-na khararchanli ot kasawui maram
kaphung-kachungli kaphika thotsai. Awui thikahaiwui saphunga A
haringkasa theichithei kachiva thotna athumli thang taracham kachithei
Varivarawui kazingramwui tui hosa. Mangan Kathara nithumwui kachungli
raranglikha nithum pangmashan phunglikha; kala Jerusalemli, Judea kala
Samaria ram kachivali, kala ngalei pammai kashung kachivali Iwui
sakhibing salikha. Athumna theishak phashokda Matthiasli rasai, kala aya
kachatbing tarakhatli ngasohailsai.
ENGLISH TRANSLATION:
The former treatise have I made, O Theophilus, of all that Jesus began
both to do and teach. To whom also he shewed himself alive after his
passion by many infallible proofs, being seen of them forty days. But ye
shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye
shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judaea, and in
Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth. And they gave forth
their lots; and the lot fell upon Matthias; and he was numbered with the
eleven apostles.

pages.title: Chapter 1 Exercises & Vocabulary
lines: CHAPTER 1 STUDY GUIDE & EXERCISES
VOCABULARY:
* Kachatbing (noun plural): apostles, authoritative emissaries
* Pangmashan (noun): power, divine might, spiritual authority
* Sakhibing (noun plural): witnesses, testifiers to truth
* Theishak (noun): lots, divine casting of decision
GRAMMAR & LINGUISTIC POINTS:
- Tangkhul uses the indigenous legal term 'sakhibing' (witnesses) for those testifying under solemn oath.
REVIEW EXERCISES (KHANGACHAN):
? How long was Jesus seen by the apostles after His passion?
? Who was chosen to take the place of Judas among the twelve?

lines: CHAPTER 2: PENTECOST THANGLI MANGAN KATHARA (DAY OF PENTECOST)
Summary: The descent of the Holy Spirit like rushing wind and tongues of fire, and Peter's first sermon.

accord in one place. And suddenly there came a sound from heaven as of a
rushing mighty wind, and it filled all the house where they were
sitting. And there appeared unto them cloven tongues like as of fire,
and it sat upon each of them. And they were all filled with the Holy
Ghost, and began to speak with other tongues. Then Peter stood up and
said, Ye men of Israel, hear these words; This Jesus hath God raised up,
whereof we all are witnesses. Repent, and be baptized every one of you
in the name of Jesus Christ.
pages.tangkhul_content: Pentecost kumshang phungphatli nithum pam akhangli zikahai pamsai. Kazingwui huchiphung majung katha khara rasai, kala athum pamsahai shim kachivali kapingsai. Kala meiwui malei katha khangayeida athum kachivawui kachungli rasai. Kala athum kachiva Mangan Katharana kapingda ngatei tui khangayei hosa! Peterna ngakarangda hosa: Israel miwung, tui hi ngashonlu: Nazarethwui Jesu hili Varivarana thikahaiwui ngachaili thingkashangsai; chiwui maramli ithum kachiva sakhibing thotsai. Ningzan ngashunlu, kala nithum kachiva Jesu Christawui minli baptisma sayanlu!
pages.english_translation: And when the day of Pentecost was fully come, they were all with one accord in one place. And suddenly there came a sound from heaven as of a rushing mighty wind, and it filled all the house where they were sitting. And there appeared unto them cloven tongues like as of fire, and it sat upon each of them. And they were all filled with the Holy Ghost, and began to speak with other tongues. Then Peter stood up and said, Ye men of Israel, hear these words; This Jesus hath God raised up, whereof we all are witnesses. Repent, and be baptized every one of you in the name of Jesus Christ.

pages.header: Chapter 3: Temple Gate wui Pamli Thotkhamatei (Lame Man at the Beautiful Gate) (Page 10)
pages.title: Chapter 3: Temple Gate wui Pamli Thotkhamatei (Lame Man at the Beautiful Gate)
lines: CHAPTER 3: TEMPLE GATE WUI PAMLI THOTKHAMATEI (LAME MAN AT THE BEAUTIFUL GATE)
Summary: Healing of the lame man by Peter and John at the Beautiful Gate of the Temple.
TANGKHUL READING TEXT:
Peter kala John thangkhamir pung chiko khangamor thangli Templeli
zangvangasai. Phaphuk khazat akhat, awui phankahaiwui thotli theisai,
aya Templewui Mathan Gate kahowali pamsai; aya Peter kala Johnli theida
seisan khamor khanasai. Peterna hosa: Rupa kala sona iwui chungli mathai
mana; kha ina phungli nali khamlikha: Nazarethwui Jesu Christawui minli
ngakarangda zatlu! Kala ayana awui pangkasho pangda thingkasangsai;
chitharan awui phakhur kala pharu pangmashan phungsai! Aya ngachor-da
ngakarangsai kala zat-zangsai, Templeli zangda khangachor kala
Varivarali mathankashei sasai.
ENGLISH TRANSLATION:
Now Peter and John went up together into the temple at the hour of
prayer, being the ninth hour. And a certain man lame from his mother's
womb was carried, whom they laid daily at the gate of the temple which
is called Beautiful, to ask alms of them that entered into the temple.
Then Peter said, Silver and gold have I none; but such as I have give I
thee: In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth rise up and walk. And he
took him by the right hand, and lifted him up: and immediately his feet
and ankle bones received strength. And he leaping up stood, and walked,
and entered with them into the temple, walking, and leaping, and
praising God.
pages.tangkhul_content: Peter kala John thangkhamir pung chiko khangamor thangli Templeli zangvangasai. Phaphuk khazat akhat, awui phankahaiwui thotli theisai, aya Templewui Mathan Gate kahowali pamsai; aya Peter kala Johnli theida seisan khamor khanasai. Peterna hosa: Rupa kala sona iwui chungli mathai mana; kha ina phungli nali khamlikha: Nazarethwui Jesu Christawui minli ngakarangda zatlu! Kala ayana awui pangkasho pangda thingkasangsai; chitharan awui phakhur kala pharu pangmashan phungsai! Aya ngachor-da ngakarangsai kala zat-zangsai, Templeli zangda khangachor kala Varivarali mathankashei sasai.
pages.english_translation: Now Peter and John went up together into the temple at the hour of prayer, being the ninth hour. And a certain man lame from his mother's womb was carried, whom they laid daily at the gate of the temple which is called Beautiful, to ask alms of them that entered into the temple. Then Peter said, Silver and gold have I none; but such as I have give I thee: In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth rise up and walk. And he took him by the right hand, and lifted him up: and immediately his feet and ankle bones received strength. And he leaping up stood, and walked, and entered with them into the temple, walking, and leaping, and praising God.

pages.header: Chapter 4: Councilwui Phungli Sakhi Chitheikahai (Before the Sanhedrin) (Page 12)
pages.title: Chapter 4: Councilwui Phungli Sakhi Chitheikahai (Before the Sanhedrin)
lines: CHAPTER 4: COUNCILWUI PHUNGLI SAKHI CHITHEIKAHAI (BEFORE THE SANHEDRIN)
Summary: Peter and John arrested and questioned before the rulers, elders, and scribes of the Council.
TANGKHUL READING TEXT:
Athumna Peter kala Johnli ngachaili pamsahai hosa: Khipawui pangmashan
kala minli nithumna hi sakha? Peterna Mangan Katharana kapingda hosa:
Miwungwui khararbing kala Israelwui Hangvabing, ngatei khipawui
chunglikha haring kaphan mathailak mana; maramchilu kazing kaphungli
miwungli khami ngatei min khikha mathai mana! Kha athumna Peter kala
Johnna ngahanda hosa: Nithumwui tui ngashon-katha Varivarawui tui
ngashon-katha khipana mashungkha nithum shanshilu! Maramchilu ithumna
theikahai kala ngashokahai tui masasa pamtang mathailak mana.
ENGLISH TRANSLATION:
And when they had set them in the midst, they asked, By what power, or
by what name, have ye done this? Then Peter, filled with the Holy Ghost,
said unto them, Ye rulers of the people, and elders of Israel, Neither
is there salvation in any other: for there is none other name under
heaven given among men, whereby we must be saved. But Peter and John
answered and said unto them, Whether it be right in the sight of God to
hearken unto you more than unto God, judge ye. For we cannot but speak
the things which we have seen and heard.
pages.tangkhul_content: Athumna Peter kala Johnli ngachaili pamsahai hosa: Khipawui pangmashan kala minli nithumna hi sakha? Peterna Mangan Katharana kapingda hosa: Miwungwui khararbing kala Israelwui Hangvabing, ngatei khipawui chunglikha haring kaphan mathailak mana; maramchilu kazing kaphungli miwungli khami ngatei min khikha mathai mana! Kha athumna Peter kala Johnna ngahanda hosa: Nithumwui tui ngashon-katha Varivarawui tui ngashon-katha khipana mashungkha nithum shanshilu! Maramchilu ithumna theikahai kala ngashokahai tui masasa pamtang mathailak mana.
pages.english_translation: And when they had set them in the midst, they asked, By what power, or by what name, have ye done this? Then Peter, filled with the Holy Ghost, said unto them, Ye rulers of the people, and elders of Israel, Neither is there salvation in any other: for there is none other name under heaven given among men, whereby we must be saved. But Peter and John answered and said unto them, Whether it be right in the sight of God to hearken unto you more than unto God, judge ye. For we cannot but speak the things which we have seen and heard.

pages.header: Chapter 5: Stephenwui Pao kala Kashung Thot (The Martyrdom of Stephen) (Page 14)
pages.title: Chapter 5: Stephenwui Pao kala Kashung Thot (The Martyrdom of Stephen)
lines: CHAPTER 5: STEPHENWUI PAO KALA KASHUNG THOT (THE MARTYRDOM OF STEPHEN)
Summary: Stephen's defense before the council, vision of the Son of Man, and stoning as the first Christian martyr.
TANGKHUL READING TEXT:
Stephenna ning-kachang kala pangmashan phungda miwungwui ngachaili
theichithei kaphung sasai. Council shimli pambing kachivana ali theida
awui mai kazingram kachisowui mai katha theisai. Kha aya Mangan
Katharana kapingda kazingli theida Varivarawui mathankashak theisai.
Kala athumna lungna chidatli Stephenna khon-kaphung: O Mapao Jesu, iwui
mangankhali khaphanlu! Kala aya phakhur phumda kaho: O Mapao, kakhama hi
athumwui chungli machonlu! Hi hoda aya thikahaisai. Saulna awui
thikahaili ningkachang phungsai.
ENGLISH TRANSLATION:
And Stephen, full of faith and power, did great wonders and miracles
among the people. And all that sat in the council, looking stedfastly on
him, saw his face as it had been the face of an angel. But he, being
full of the Holy Ghost, looked up stedfastly into heaven, and saw the
glory of God. And they stoned Stephen, calling upon God, and saying,
Lord Jesus, receive my spirit. And he kneeled down, and cried with a
loud voice, Lord, lay not this sin to their charge. And when he had said
this, he fell asleep. And Saul was consenting unto his death.
pages.tangkhul_content: Stephenna ning-kachang kala pangmashan phungda miwungwui ngachaili theichithei kaphung sasai. Council shimli pambing kachivana ali theida awui mai kazingram kachisowui mai katha theisai. Kha aya Mangan Katharana kapingda kazingli theida Varivarawui mathankashak theisai. Kala athumna lungna chidatli Stephenna khon-kaphung: O Mapao Jesu, iwui mangankhali khaphanlu! Kala aya phakhur phumda kaho: O Mapao, kakhama hi athumwui chungli machonlu! Hi hoda aya thikahaisai. Saulna awui thikahaili ningkachang phungsai.
pages.english_translation: And Stephen, full of faith and power, did great wonders and miracles among the people. And all that sat in the council, looking stedfastly on him, saw his face as it had been the face of an angel. But he, being full of the Holy Ghost, looked up stedfastly into heaven, and saw the glory of God. And they stoned Stephen, calling upon God, and saying, Lord Jesus, receive my spirit. And he kneeled down, and cried with a loud voice, Lord, lay not this sin to their charge. And when he had said this, he fell asleep. And Saul was consenting unto his death.

pages.header: Chapter 6: Corneliusli Pao Kazang (Conversion of Cornelius) (Page 16)
pages.title: Chapter 6: Corneliusli Pao Kazang (Conversion of Cornelius)
lines: CHAPTER 6: CORNELIUSLI PAO KAZANG (CONVERSION OF CORNELIUS)
Summary: Peter's vision of the clean and unclean animals, journey to Caesarea, and the gospel opened to the Gentiles.
TANGKHUL READING TEXT:
Caesarea ramli Cornelius kahona Italian cohortwui centurion akhat
pamsai. Aya Varivarali kacharan, awui shim kachiva ngasoda, miwungli
dori khami kala Varivarali thang kachiva khangamor. Peterna Caesareali
rada hosa: Kaphung-kachangli ina theisai Varivarana mi akhatli kaching
mei mana; kha ram kachivali Ali kacharan kala mashungkasa chi Awui
ningkachang phungsai. Peterna tui hi holikha Mangan Katharana tui
ngashonbing kachivawui chungli rasai!
ENGLISH TRANSLATION:
There was a certain man in Caesarea called Cornelius, a centurion of the
band called the Italian band, A devout man, and one that feared God with
all his house, which gave much alms to the people, and prayed to God
alway. Then Peter opened his mouth, and said, Of a truth I perceive that
God is no respecter of persons: But in every nation he that feareth him,
and worketh righteousness, is accepted with him. While Peter yet spake
these words, the Holy Ghost fell on all them which heard the word.
pages.tangkhul_content: Caesarea ramli Cornelius kahona Italian cohortwui centurion akhat pamsai. Aya Varivarali kacharan, awui shim kachiva ngasoda, miwungli dori khami kala Varivarali thang kachiva khangamor. Peterna Caesareali rada hosa: Kaphung-kachangli ina theisai Varivarana mi akhatli kaching mei mana; kha ram kachivali Ali kacharan kala mashungkasa chi Awui ningkachang phungsai. Peterna tui hi holikha Mangan Katharana tui ngashonbing kachivawui chungli rasai!
pages.english_translation: There was a certain man in Caesarea called Cornelius, a centurion of the band called the Italian band, A devout man, and one that feared God with all his house, which gave much alms to the people, and prayed to God alway. Then Peter opened his mouth, and said, Of a truth I perceive that God is no respecter of persons: But in every nation he that feareth him, and worketh righteousness, is accepted with him. While Peter yet spake these words, the Holy Ghost fell on all them which heard the word.

pages.header: Chapter 7: Athens Ramli Paulna Tui Chitheikahai (Paul at the Areopagus) (Page 18)
pages.title: Chapter 7: Athens Ramli Paulna Tui Chitheikahai (Paul at the Areopagus)
lines: CHAPTER 7: ATHENS RAMLI PAULNA TUI CHITHEIKAHAI (PAUL AT THE AREOPAGUS)
Summary: Paul's sermon at Mars Hill in Athens concerning the Unknown God, repentance, and resurrection.
TANGKHUL READING TEXT:
Paulna Areopagus (Mars Hill) ngachaili ngakarangda hosa: Athens miwung,
ina theisai nithum thang kachiva kameo khangamor phungsai; maramchilu
ina zatli nithumwui altar akhatli kaphika theisai: MATHIKAHAI
VARIVARALI. Nithumna matheila khangamor hili ina chitheikhami! Kazing
kala ngalei kala chili leisatha kachiva sakahai Varivara chili kazing
kala ngaleiwui Mapaosai, Aya mina sakahai templeli mapam mana;
maramchilu Awui chungli ithum haring, zatta, kala pamsai; nithumwui la-
kashabingna hokatha: 'Ithumya Awui kachung thotsai.'
ENGLISH TRANSLATION:
Then Paul stood in the midst of Mars' hill, and said, Ye men of Athens,
I perceive that in all things ye are too superstitious. For as I passed
by, and beheld your devotions, I found an altar with this inscription,
TO THE UNKNOWN GOD. Whom therefore ye ignorantly worship, him declare I
unto you. God that made the world and all things therein, seeing that he
is Lord of heaven and earth, dwelleth not in temples made with hands;
For in him we live, and move, and have our being; as certain also of
your own poets have said, For we are also his offspring.

excerpts.chapter: Chapter 1: Kazingli Kaphan kala Kachatbing (Ascension and Commission)
excerpts.tangkhul_text: Theophilus-li kaphung kakhanin: Jesu-na khararchanli ot kasawui maram kaphung-kachungli kaphika thotsai. Awui thikahaiwui saphunga A haringkasa theichithei kachiva thotna athumli thang taracham kachithei Varivarawui kazingramwui tui hosa. Mangan Kathara nithumwui kachungli raranglikha nithum pangmashan phunglikha; kala Jerusalemli, Judea kala Samaria ram kachivali, kala ngalei pammai kashung kachivali Iwui sakhibing salikha. Athumna theishak phashokda Matthiasli rasai, kala aya kachatbing tarakhatli ngasohailsai.
excerpts.translation_en: The former treatise have I made, O Theophilus, of all that Jesus began both to do and teach. To whom also he shewed himself alive after his passion by many infallible proofs, being seen of them forty days. But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judaea, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth. And they gave forth their lots; and the lot fell upon Matthias; and he was numbered with the eleven apostles.

excerpts.chapter: Chapter 2: Pentecost Thangli Mangan Kathara (Day of Pentecost)
excerpts.tangkhul_text: Pentecost kumshang phungphatli nithum pam akhangli zikahai pamsai. Kazingwui huchiphung majung katha khara rasai, kala athum pamsahai shim kachivali kapingsai. Kala meiwui malei katha khangayeida athum kachivawui kachungli rasai. Kala athum kachiva Mangan Katharana kapingda ngatei tui khangayei hosa! Peterna ngakarangda hosa: Israel miwung, tui hi ngashonlu: Nazarethwui Jesu hili Varivarana thikahaiwui ngachaili thingkashangsai; chiwui maramli ithum kachiva sakhibing thotsai. Ningzan ngashunlu, kala nithum kachiva Jesu Christawui minli baptisma sayanlu!
excerpts.translation_en: And when the day of Pentecost was fully come, they were all with one accord in one place. And suddenly there came a sound from heaven as of a rushing mighty wind, and it filled all the house where they were sitting. And there appeared unto them cloven tongues like as of fire, and it sat upon each of them. And they were all filled with the Holy Ghost, and began to speak with other tongues. Then Peter stood up and said, Ye men of Israel, hear these words; This Jesus hath God raised up, whereof we all are witnesses. Repent, and be baptized every one of you in the name of Jesus Christ.

excerpts.chapter: Chapter 3: Temple Gate wui Pamli Thotkhamatei (Lame Man at the Beautiful Gate)
excerpts.tangkhul_text: Peter kala John thangkhamir pung chiko khangamor thangli Templeli zangvangasai. Phaphuk khazat akhat, awui phankahaiwui thotli theisai, aya Templewui Mathan Gate kahowali pamsai; aya Peter kala Johnli theida seisan khamor khanasai. Peterna hosa: Rupa kala sona iwui chungli mathai mana; kha ina phungli nali khamlikha: Nazarethwui Jesu Christawui minli ngakarangda zatlu! Kala ayana awui pangkasho pangda thingkasangsai; chitharan awui phakhur kala pharu pangmashan phungsai! Aya ngachor-da ngakarangsai kala zat-zangsai, Templeli zangda khangachor kala Varivarali mathankashei sasai.
excerpts.translation_en: Now Peter and John went up together into the temple at the hour of prayer, being the ninth hour. And a certain man lame from his mother's womb was carried, whom they laid daily at the gate of the temple which is called Beautiful, to ask alms of them that entered into the temple. Then Peter said, Silver and gold have I none; but such as I have give I thee: In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth rise up and walk. And he took him by the right hand, and lifted him up: and immediately his feet and ankle bones received strength. And he leaping up stood, and walked, and entered with them into the temple, walking, and leaping, and praising God.

excerpts.chapter: Chapter 4: Councilwui Phungli Sakhi Chitheikahai (Before the Sanhedrin)
excerpts.tangkhul_text: Athumna Peter kala Johnli ngachaili pamsahai hosa: Khipawui pangmashan kala minli nithumna hi sakha? Peterna Mangan Katharana kapingda hosa: Miwungwui khararbing kala Israelwui Hangvabing, ngatei khipawui chunglikha haring kaphan mathailak mana; maramchilu kazing kaphungli miwungli khami ngatei min khikha mathai mana! Kha athumna Peter kala Johnna ngahanda hosa: Nithumwui tui ngashon-katha Varivarawui tui ngashon-katha khipana mashungkha nithum shanshilu! Maramchilu ithumna theikahai kala ngashokahai tui masasa pamtang mathailak mana.
excerpts.translation_en: And when they had set them in the midst, they asked, By what power, or by what name, have ye done this? Then Peter, filled with the Holy Ghost, said unto them, Ye rulers of the people, and elders of Israel, Neither is there salvation in any other: for there is none other name under heaven given among men, whereby we must be saved. But Peter and John answered and said unto them, Whether it be right in the sight of God to hearken unto you more than unto God, judge ye. For we cannot but speak the things which we have seen and heard.

excerpts.chapter: Chapter 5: Stephenwui Pao kala Kashung Thot (The Martyrdom of Stephen)
excerpts.tangkhul_text: Stephenna ning-kachang kala pangmashan phungda miwungwui ngachaili theichithei kaphung sasai. Council shimli pambing kachivana ali theida awui mai kazingram kachisowui mai katha theisai. Kha aya Mangan Katharana kapingda kazingli theida Varivarawui mathankashak theisai. Kala athumna lungna chidatli Stephenna khon-kaphung: O Mapao Jesu, iwui mangankhali khaphanlu! Kala aya phakhur phumda kaho: O Mapao, kakhama hi athumwui chungli machonlu! Hi hoda aya thikahaisai. Saulna awui thikahaili ningkachang phungsai.
excerpts.translation_en: And Stephen, full of faith and power, did great wonders and miracles among the people. And all that sat in the council, looking stedfastly on him, saw his face as it had been the face of an angel. But he, being full of the Holy Ghost, looked up stedfastly into heaven, and saw the glory of God. And they stoned Stephen, calling upon God, and saying, Lord Jesus, receive my spirit. And he kneeled down, and cried with a loud voice, Lord, lay not this sin to their charge. And when he had said this, he fell asleep. And Saul was consenting unto his death.

excerpts.chapter: Chapter 6: Corneliusli Pao Kazang (Conversion of Cornelius)
excerpts.tangkhul_text: Caesarea ramli Cornelius kahona Italian cohortwui centurion akhat pamsai. Aya Varivarali kacharan, awui shim kachiva ngasoda, miwungli dori khami kala Varivarali thang kachiva khangamor. Peterna Caesareali rada hosa: Kaphung-kachangli ina theisai Varivarana mi akhatli kaching mei mana; kha ram kachivali Ali kacharan kala mashungkasa chi Awui ningkachang phungsai. Peterna tui hi holikha Mangan Katharana tui ngashonbing kachivawui chungli rasai!
excerpts.translation_en: There was a certain man in Caesarea called Cornelius, a centurion of the band called the Italian band, A devout man, and one that feared God with all his house, which gave much alms to the people, and prayed to God alway. Then Peter opened his mouth, and said, Of a truth I perceive that God is no respecter of persons: But in every nation he that feareth him, and worketh righteousness, is accepted with him. While Peter yet spake these words, the Holy Ghost fell on all them which heard the word.

excerpts.chapter: Chapter 7: Athens Ramli Paulna Tui Chitheikahai (Paul at the Areopagus)
excerpts.tangkhul_text: Paulna Areopagus (Mars Hill) ngachaili ngakarangda hosa: Athens miwung, ina theisai nithum thang kachiva kameo khangamor phungsai; maramchilu ina zatli nithumwui altar akhatli kaphika theisai: MATHIKAHAI VARIVARALI. Nithumna matheila khangamor hili ina chitheikhami! Kazing kala ngalei kala chili leisatha kachiva sakahai Varivara chili kazing kala ngaleiwui Mapaosai, Aya mina sakahai templeli mapam mana; maramchilu Awui chungli ithum haring, zatta, kala pamsai; nithumwui la-kashabingna hokatha: 'Ithumya Awui kachung thotsai.'
excerpts.translation_en: Then Paul stood in the midst of Mars' hill, and said, Ye men of Athens, I perceive that in all things ye are too superstitious. For as I passed by, and beheld your devotions, I found an altar with this inscription, TO THE UNKNOWN GOD. Whom therefore ye ignorantly worship, him declare I unto you. God that made the world and all things therein, seeing that he is Lord of heaven and earth, dwelleth not in temples made with hands; For in him we live, and move, and have our being; as certain also of your own poets have said, For we are also his offspring.
